Use case: precise-object-edit / identity-preserve. Edit image 1, the current finished Open Graph card. Image 2 is the original portrait of the real Yulia Popova, the identity reference. Image 3 is the user's preferred botanical style detail.
Replace ONLY the oval portrait composition with a mathematically round circular portrait medallion: its width MUST equal its height, not an ellipse, not an arch, not a pill, not a blob. Keep the whole circle visible inside the horizontal card, with generous margins above and below. Portrait and shoulders are entirely clipped within the circle, no hair or shoulders extending past the circular perimeter. Faithfully preserve the original person's recognizable face, age, eyes, hair, expression and gray blazer; no beautifying or identity changes. Pale sage backdrop inside the portrait circle.
Keep the elegant warm cream #FBF8F1, sage #31513C and apricot palette, delicate textured botanical leaf branches around the outside of the circle, and coral #D53A25 website pill. Keep all text unchanged, exact Russian: "Юлия Попова", "Психолог • Тьютор • Профориентолог", "Онлайн и очно в Москве", "popovatalk.ru". Elegant Cyrillic serif name and clean sans-serif subtitles. Keep left text / right portrait layout; adjust scale only as needed so the circle is fully visible and every line readable. No extra wording, logos, reviews, diplomas or watermark.
Output one final full-bleed horizontal card at 1200 x 630, approximately 1.905:1. The portrait frame itself is a perfect circle.
